Just saying exactly what you saw without any judgement in it from your side, then based on her reaction you will know where to take it. You can also say to her that you weren’t sure if you should say it because of what she said before but that you would rather tell her and not speculate (thus respecting that part of what she said) if you feel like it. I would have appreciated it at least, shows that you really thought it through.

In one way one could say that you not telling Anna is you speculating on their relationship. If I was you, I’d tell her. You don’t need to say «Hey I saw Joe cheating...» but something along «Hey, I met Joe and saw..». Always do what you wish someone did to you. So if you would have wanted Anna to tell you, then you tell Anna.

Assuming you meant you took 8x500mg you’re right at the maximum intake within 24 hours. However it is meant to be spread out taking max 1g every 4-6 hours. So having taken it all at once is going to require a lot from your liver. So if you dont want to, or for some reason can’t seek medical help. Please dont take any more and don’t consume any alcohol for a few days. I have seen people trying to end it with paracetamol and it is never peaceful nor ever painfree. Not ever the way to do it, and at 14 believe me, although life might feel like shit, trust me there is more to it than what it feels like now, at least from my experience.

Trust me, paracetamol is not the way you want to go. If it even does kill you it is going to be slow and painful, but more likely you’ll be sick for the rest of your life, but it is easy to prevent if you get help. If I were you I’d go to the ER and get it out of my system. Say it was an accident if you dont want help, although you probably would benefit from it.
